title: Halving-count coordinate
statement: For every counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the register vector of $\sigma$ has value $lg$ at coordinate $1$.
replaced:
For a state whose 17-entry encoding lists, in order, its input length, halving count,
add-twice counter, window radius, code-bound exponent, code bound, doubling scratch
register, stage, stage plus one, known-ball size, outer vertex, next-ball count, inner
vertex, inner count, guessed code, current walk code, and walk step count, the entry at
index $1$ is the halving count.
